newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Associated Cement starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Associated Cement starts.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said on Monday it had started coverage of India's Associated Cement Cos with a sell rating at a price of 1,545 rupees.

-- "Given ACC's poor earnings forecasts, relatively low operating margins, and heavy focus on the weaker northern and eastern India cement markets, we believe its shares are overvalued," analyst Ajay Malpini wrote.
-- "Furthermore, its product diversification into areas such as advanced materials and mining will not bear fruit in the short term."
-- Fleming set a 12-month price target of 1,775 rupees.
